mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 34 degrees with overcast skies near the Reddan Soccer Park under a waning gibbous moon.

Important election news: 2027 Spring Election candidate packets are now available. If you plan to run for an Aldermanic seat, ensure all forms are submitted to the City Clerk by 5:00 p.m. on January 5, 2027.

It is a busy week for entertainment. Today, enjoy live music at Bailey is Run or the 50th-anniversary celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Crafty Fair at ART House 360 or music at Paddy Mac is.
In our weekly report, officers responded to a call on November 6 where a woman was found passed out in a vehicle at a business on West Verona Avenue, resulting in an O W I arrest.
Our flavor of the day is the delightful Snickers Swirl. Culver is of Verona opens today at 10:00 AM, so make sure to stop by and satisfy your sweet tooth.
